selection_rule: All verified registry items with page_count 61 through 75 inclusive; prior <=60-page tranches are COMPLETE and excluded.

constraints.rights: Recheck exact item location PDM and open access before retrieval.
constraints.retrieval: Anonymous official Wellcome API/IIIF only; no access-control bypass.
constraints.preservation: Every page, raw work metadata and manifest, hashes, Drive fingerprint readback, checkpoint and COMPLETE.
constraints.capacity_gate: Bounded 61-75 page tranche only; do not expand beyond these 19 until exact observed bytes and Drive audit are known.
